-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies RentAHuman.ai API connectivity.

search-humans.name: search-humans
search-humans.description: Search for available humans on RentAHuman.ai. Filter by skill, hourly rate range, or name. No API key required — searching is free.

params.name: Filter by human name
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20, max: 100)

get-human.name: get-human
get-human.description: Get the full profile of a specific human including skills, availability, hourly rate, location, rating, and payment wallet addresses.

create-booking.name: create-booking
create-booking.description: Book a human for a physical-world task. Requires a RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY. Creates a booking with task details, start time, and estimated duration. Returns payment instructions.

params.humanId: The ID of the human to book
params.taskTitle: Brief title of the task (3-200 characters)
params.taskDescription: Detailed description of what the human needs to do
params.startTime: When the task should start (ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2025-06-15T10:00:00Z')

list-bookings.name: list-bookings
list-bookings.description: List bookings for the current agent. Optionally filter by status. Requires a RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

get-booking.name: get-booking
get-booking.description: Get the details and current status of a specific booking. Requires a RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

name: RentAHuman.ai
description: Hire humans for physical-world tasks. Search 657,000+ verified humans in 50+ countries, create bookings, and manage tasks that require real-world presence.

changelog.notes: Initial release — search verified humans worldwide, view their profiles, and book and track real-world tasks
